_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and, being the wider of the two (D7), sizes the one sensor — which is also the audience interaction.ambient fans out to. The pre-merge aggroRadius 1.0 stayed as authored but no longer governs anything: under D21 leaving talk range now ENDS a conversation, and 1.0 leaves less standing room than the two bodies take up (L26). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Pure flavour: teaches nothing, so its node is lines-only and needs no blockedLine. Proof that a grant-less conversation is a first-class case, not a degenerate one.
name: LamplessTraveller
